```{.r .cell-code}
BRA <- ne_states(country = "Brazil", 
                  returnclass = "sf")
              

library(tidyverse)

ggplot(BRA)+
  geom_sf(color= "white",
          fill = "darkgreen")+
  theme_classic()
```

```{.r .cell-code}
BRA <- ne_states(country= "Brazil",
                    returnclass= "sf")
MG <- BRA |> filter(name_en == "Minas Gerais")

sbr<- RustSoybean

ggplot(BRA)+
  geom_sf(color= "black",
          fill = "white")+
  geom_sf(data= MG, color = "black", fill= "red")+
  geom_point(data=sbr, aes(longitude,latitude), alpha = 0.5)
```

```{.r .cell-code}
# Separar la fecha en día, mes y año
sbr2 <- sbr %>%
  separate(planting, into = c("year", "month", "day"), sep = "-", remove = FALSE)
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ggplot(BRA)+
  #annotation_north_arrow (location = "bl",
                          #style = north_arrow_nautical())+
  #annotation_scale(location="br")+
  geom_sf(color= "black",
          fill = "white")+
  geom_point(data=sbr2, aes(longitude,latitude, color= year, 
                            size = severity), alpha = 0.5)+
  geom_hline(yintercept = -23, linetype= "dashed", color = "black")+
  theme_minimal()+
    labs(color = "Planting Year")+
    theme(legend.position = "right")
```
